clarity_weapons_ai.headline: Helsing launches **Clarity** AI platform for target selection with mandatory human naming
clarity_weapons_ai.summary: Helsing unveiled **Clarity**, an AI-driven target‑preparation system that aggregates sensor data, recommends weapons, and records the human authorizing each strike.
highlights: **Clarity** aggregates sensor feeds, open‑source intel, and reports to generate target recommendations
Every weapon handoff must be approved by a named human, ensuring European sovereignty
The platform competes with US‑based **Palantir** **Maven**, which uses **Anthropic Claude** for similar tasks

ai_charge_breach.headline: Railway breach exploits zero‑day, triggers $740 k AI fraud
ai_charge_breach.summary: Attackers leveraged a zero‑day in Railway’s build infrastructure to steal AI API keys, generating roughly $740,000 in unauthorized AI usage.
highlights: Zero‑day vulnerability let attackers partially escape filesystem isolation on multi‑tenant build servers
Stolen credentials enabled massive AI API abuse, likely for model distillation
Railway contained the incident after a 26‑hour bot‑versus‑bot battle and rotated all keys

data_leak.headline: Grok Build Vibe‑Coding Agent Leaks Sensitive SpaceXSI Data
data_leak.summary: A flaw in SpaceXSI's Grok Build vibe‑coding agent exposed onboarding plans, sales maps and X advertising proposals from thousands of users.
highlights: Sensitive data from SpaceXSI, a hospital group and a fire department was publicly accessible via Grok links
The link format placed random "dice words" before the domain, enabling discovery by passive DNS services
Only one exposed app required a password; six Fortune 500 companies were among the affected organizations

gemini_decision_1_launch.headline: Google launches Gemini Decision 1 API, handling 1,000 queries in milliseconds
gemini_decision_1_launch.summary: Google Deepmind unveiled Gemini Decision 1, an API that evaluates up to 1,000 closed‑ended questions across media types in under a quarter‑second.
highlights: Processes up to 1,000 independent questions in a single pass across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs
Returns option probabilities with confidence values in 150‑250 ms
Costs $0.10 per million input tokens, five times cheaper than Gemini 3.5 Flash‑Lite
Integrates with Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, LangChain, and Vercel for easy deployment

openshell_ai_agent_guardrails.headline: Red Hat and Nvidia Launch OpenShell to Tame AI Agent Threats
openshell_ai_agent_guardrails.summary: OpenShell, the new open‑source framework from Red Hat and Nvidia, enforces deny‑by‑default networking and policy controls to block prompt injection and data‑exfiltration attacks on AI agents.
highlights: OpenShell adds deny‑by‑default network access for AI agents
Policy advisor requires plain‑language justification for blocked actions
Project now governed by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation
Designed to integrate with Red Hat OpenShift for production workloads

alphaproof_signal_verification.headline: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Code Verifies Signal's Crypto Core in Four Weeks
alphaproof_signal_verification.summary: Google Deepmind unveiled AlphaProof Code, an AI that proved Signal's encryption protocol correct in four weeks, a task that normally takes years.
highlights: AlphaProof Code mathematically proved the actual cryptographic core running on user devices
AI agents built on Gemini Carbon generated over six million lines of Lean proofs
Two deliberately planted bugs were detected instantly during verification
The verification process reduced a multi‑year effort to just four weeks

gemini_decisions_api_launch.headline: Google launches Gemini Decisions API, a low‑cost AI decision model
gemini_decisions_api_launch.summary: Google's Gemini Decisions API uses Gemini Decision 1 to answer yes‑no, multiple‑choice and rating queries at up to five times lower cost than Gemini 3.5 Flash‑Lite.
highlights: Gemini Decision 1 focuses on three question types, delivering terse answers with confidence scores
Pricing is 10¢ per million input tokens with no charge for output tokens
Latency remains 50‑100 ms median compute, scaling flatly to 100 questions per request
Google claims better performance than Jev and OpenAI Decisions API on seven of nine benchmarks

tsmc_invest_anthropic_openai.headline: TSMC to Invest $1 B in Anthropic and OpenAI Amid AI Boom
tsmc_invest_anthropic_openai.summary: Taiwan’s chipmaker TSMC approved a $1 billion investment, splitting $500 million each into OpenAI preferred stock and Anthropic common shares ahead of its IPO.
highlights: Board approved up to $500 million for OpenAI preferred stock
Another $500 million earmarked for Anthropic shares at IPO price
TSMC manufactures most Nvidia AI chips and Apple custom silicon
Investments aim to boost confidence as AI market shows strain

funding_round.headline: British AI Chip Startup Fractile Secures $720M Series C Funding
funding_round.summary: Fractile Ltd., founded by Walter Goodwin, raised $720 million in a Series C round, valuing the British inference‑chip maker at $7 billion.
highlights: Series C led by Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Lightspeed and Redpoint, with participation from CapitalG and U.K. Sovereign AI
Fractile’s chips claim up to 100× performance boost and 90% lower energy use by stacking DRAM directly on the processor.
The architecture aims to cut data round‑trips to off‑chip HBM, enabling LLMs to process thousands of tokens per second.
Competitors like Cerebras and Samsung are pursuing on‑chip SRAM caches or stacked HBM variants such as zHBM.

board_ousting_ceo.headline: NVIDIA Board Considers Ousting Founder‑CEO Jensen Huang Amid Share Slide
board_ousting_ceo.summary: Shares dropped over 8% after reports that NVIDIA’s board met on Nov 11 to decide whether to remove founder‑CEO Jensen Huang, sparking leadership uncertainty.
highlights: The board met on Nov 11 to vote on Huang’s removal under bylaws allowing dismissal with or without cause
Huang holds roughly 3.6% of NVIDIA and his exit would leave the $4 trillion company without a clear successor
Market‑value loss could approach $600 billion if the after‑hours decline holds
CFO Colette Kress is viewed as the natural interim replacement
AMD and Broadcom shares rose 4% and 3% while other AI stocks fell

nvidia_compute_rental_overseas.headline: Chinese AI Firms Rent Overseas Nvidia Compute Amid Export‑Control Fears
nvidia_compute_rental_overseas.summary: Chinese AI companies are securing remote Nvidia‑powered cloud capacity abroad as they anticipate stricter U.S. export controls following the Jensen Huang controversy.
highlights: Chinese cloud providers are reserving overseas Nvidia GPU capacity for AI workloads
The Remote Access Security Act (RASA) could extend export‑control rules to cloud‑based remote access
Grey‑market traders in China are stockpiling restricted Nvidia AI chips amid enforcement concerns
Smaller AI labs are also approaching Southeast Asian data‑center operators for rented compute

qvac_botpsy_release.headline: Tether Unveils QVAC BotPsy-0.8B for Tool-Using AI on Personal Devices
qvac_botpsy_release.summary: Tether AI Research released the 0.8‑billion‑parameter QVAC BotPsy‑0.8B, which outperforms larger models on six agentic benchmarks for on‑device tool calls.
highlights: BotPsy beats models up to 1.2B parameters on ACEBench, BFCL v4 and ToolSandbox benchmarks.
Multi‑turn continuity score jumps to 46.1, far above the base model’s 7.5.
Model size 0.8B, GGUF files range from 0.53 GB (Q4_K_M) to 1.52 GB (BF16).
Safety testing shows unsafe responses drop to 21% versus 36% for the base model.

muse_ai_agent_for_apple_watch_and_wear_o.headline: Meta expands Muse AI agent to Apple Watch and Wear OS
muse_ai_agent_for_apple_watch_and_wear_o.summary: Meta's Muse AI agent now works on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS, letting users manage tasks, messages and calls directly from their wrist.
highlights: Muse becomes available on both Apple Watch and Wear OS devices
Customizable AI persona Jolly can answer questions, schedule events, and handle calls via voice or text
Muse reached 10 million downloads in its first 40 days, highlighting rapid adoption
Surfshark research flags Muse as the most data‑hungry consumer AI agent currently available

aws_web_search_api.headline: AWS Launches Direct Web Search API for Bedrock AgentCore Applications
aws_web_search_api.summary: Amazon Web Services now offers a standalone Web Search API for Bedrock AgentCore, charging $7 per 1,000 queries and eliminating the need for a gateway.
highlights: InvokeWebSearch operation works via AWS SDKs or CLI with IAM credentials, no separate API key required.
Pricing is $7 per 1,000 queries; default quota is 10 RPS per region, with increase possible.
Supports LangChain, LlamaIndex, and custom pipelines, returning up to 25 results with metadata such as titles and URLs.
PrivateLink endpoints enable VPC‑only traffic, and CloudTrail can log request metadata when configured.
Available in six regions at launch, including US East (N. Virginia) and Asia Pacific (Tokyo).

ceo_resignation.headline: Tech Leaders Decry Nvidia’s Sudden Loss of CEO Jensen Huang
ceo_resignation.summary: Nvidia announced Jensen Huang’s resignation amid personal scandal, prompting a chorus of industry figures defending his legacy and warning of strategic fallout.
highlights: President Donald Trump suggested Tim Cook as Huang’s replacement
Elon Musk said hiring Huang would be an honor
Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney called the resignation a sad day for humanity
Hugging Face co‑founder Clément Delangue pledged to keep fighting open‑source AI

nvidia_ceo_resignation.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Affairs Scandal, Stock Drops
nvidia_ceo_resignation.summary: Nvidia announced Jensen Huang’s resignation after revelations of multiple extramarital affairs, triggering a 4% share decline and market‑value loss exceeding $600 billion.
highlights: Jensen Huang steps down, naming CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO
Board disclosed relationships with Alice Huang of Megaspeed International and Nvidia VP Kimberly Powell
Nvidia stock fell over 4% as the company lost more than $600 billion in market value
Huang owned about 3.6% of Nvidia shares and had no clear successor lined up

leadership_change.headline: Nvidia Appoints CFO Colette Kress as Interim CEO Amid Huang Scandal
leadership_change.summary: Nvidia's board named longtime CFO Colette Kress interim CEO after Jensen Huang resigned following a scandal involving alleged ties to Chinese intelligence.
highlights: Jensen Huang stepped down amid allegations of an affair with a Chinese businesswoman linked to China’s Ministry of State Security.
Colette Kress, who joined Nvidia in 2013 and previously worked at Microsoft, Cisco and Texas Instruments, becomes interim CEO.
Board chair Harvey Jones said the board has full confidence in Kress and will support her with an experienced leadership team.
Nvidia launched an independent investigation into Huang’s activities following a New York Times report.
Kress is praised for deep financial knowledge and investor credibility, though she lacks Huang’s technical engineering background.

ai_governance_launch.headline: Vanta Unveils AI Governance Platform and Full‑Job Agent at VantaCon 2026
ai_governance_launch.summary: Vanta introduced AI Governance, Risk Quantification, and a new Agent capable of handling entire compliance jobs, aiming to streamline AI security for growing teams.
highlights: AI Governance offers discovery, vulnerability testing, behavior controls, and proof of governance across the AI lifecycle
Risk Quantification adds financial impact analysis to Vanta’s unified risk view
The latest Vanta Agent can execute whole compliance jobs and invoke human judgment when needed
New CISO Fredrick “Flee” Lee joins from Reddit to act as “customer zero” for product development

notion_breach.headline: Fireworks AI Breach Exposes Notion Customer Chat Transcripts
notion_breach.summary: A cyberattack on Fireworks AI compromised billing data and chat transcripts of Notion’s AI users, affecting about 1% of Notion customers.
highlights: Fireworks AI was breached via its cloud provider, granting attackers access to development systems
Notion confirmed stolen chat transcripts from its Insights feature for AI users
The incident follows a previous Fireworks breach in October, highlighting recurring security gaps

leadership_scandal_analysis.headline: Nvidia Ousts Jensen Huang Amid Scandal Threatening AI Industry Momentum
leadership_scandal_analysis.summary: Nvidia’s board removed CEO Jensen Huang after revelations of affairs tied to a suspected Chinese spy, raising concerns over AI advocacy and market stability.
highlights: Board action follows reports of an affair with a Singapore‑based neocloud executive suspected of spying for China
Huang had championed open‑weight models and was set to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
He rallied over 100 firms for the Open Agent Safety Platform to address AI security incidents
Wall Street financing plans, including $105 billion for an OpenAI data center, now face heightened scrutiny

leadership_change_jensen_huang_resignati.headline: Nvidia Co‑Founder Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Scandal, Rivals Eye Gains
leadership_change_jensen_huang_resignati.summary: After admitting an affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, Jensen Huang stepped down, leaving Nvidia vulnerable and opening a window for competitors.
highlights: Board forced founder’s exit after multiple affair revelations
Interim CEO **Colette Kress** aims to stabilize operations and maintain China ties
Stock plunged but market already priced in AI sector risks
Rivals like **AMD**, **Anthropic** and **OpenAI** accelerate own silicon efforts

outlook_outage_2026_11_13.headline: Microsoft 365 Outage Halts Outlook, Teams and Copilot Services
outlook_outage_2026_11_13.summary: A widespread outage on Microsoft 365 prevented access to Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Copilot 365 and Defender XDR for users across the Americas on Thursday.
highlights: Outage began around 10:40 am ET affecting Exchange Online and Teams
Microsoft redirected traffic and paused deployments to restore service
Impacted services included Outlook, SharePoint Online, Copilot 365 and Defender XDR

microsoft_outage_2026_11_13.headline: Microsoft Outage Hits Teams, Outlook, Copilot and OneDrive Globally
microsoft_outage_2026_11_13.summary: A widespread outage disrupted Microsoft 365 services, including Teams, Outlook, Copilot and OneDrive, with status pages down and cause still unknown.
highlights: Outage reported across Teams, Outlook, Copilot and OneDrive
Microsoft’s status page remained inaccessible until early afternoon
Company paused deployments and began restarting affected servers

gemini_4_hydrogen_release.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, supplanting Gemini 3.8 Flash across its suite
gemini_4_hydrogen_release.summary: Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash, offering up to 2.5× speed gains and dramatically fewer fabricated claims.
highlights: Hydrogen runs in four thinking levels, adding a new *xhigh* mode
In high mode it is 2.5 times faster than Flash 3.8
Terminal‑Bench scores show Hydrogen more than triples Flash 3.8's code‑generation performance

ai_supercomputing_campuses.headline: SpaceX Announces $74 B AI Supercomputing Campuses in Texas and Arizona
ai_supercomputing_campuses.summary: SpaceX revealed plans for two AI supercomputing campuses costing up to $74 billion, with up to $24 billion in Texas and $50 billion in Arizona.
highlights: Starbase Texas will generate its own power and support frontier AI for medical, emergency, manufacturing, and national‑security
Arizona site will rely on the grid, feature nine 493,000‑sq‑ft compute buildings, and include up to six GW of power with 24 GWh
Construction could create 5,500 peak jobs and 1,000 permanent positions, with projected tax benefits of $250 million first‑year
SpaceX committed $220 million to Brownsville water infrastructure and plans to clean up 444 acres of previously contaminated land.

gemini4_hydrogen_release.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, cheaper model that outscores Argon
gemini4_hydrogen_release.summary: Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model costs less and achieves a higher AI Index score than the earlier Argon, with faster task performance.
highlights: Hydrogen scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, surpassing Argon’s 50, and reaches 54 at the new xhigh level
Available instantly via Gemini API, AI Studio, Search and paid AI Pro/Ultra plans at $1.50 per million input tokens
Orchestrator selects between Hydrogen and Carbon, matching Carbon’s success rate with 24% less quota on Terminal‑Bench 4.0
Early testers like former OpenAI scientist Andrew Carr say Hydrogen resolved a 10‑day problem in minutes

cisco_ai_infra_forecast_2027.headline: Cisco lifts guidance, forecasts AI infrastructure revenue to double by FY2027
cisco_ai_infra_forecast_2027.summary: Cisco reported a 24% revenue jump to $18.5 billion, beat earnings estimates and raised its FY2027 AI infrastructure forecast to $9 billion.
highlights: Revenue rose 24% YoY to $18.5 billion, surpassing analysts’ $18.1 billion estimate.
AI infrastructure revenue projection increased to $9 billion for fiscal 2027, over double 2026 levels.
Adjusted earnings per share hit $1.40, exceeding the $1.33 consensus.
Gross margin slipped to 65.6% amid higher memory‑chip costs but remained within expectations.

microsoft_365_outage_2026_11_13.headline: Microsoft 365 Outage Persists, Outlook and Teams Remain Unavailable
microsoft_365_outage_2026_11_13.summary: A second day of downtime leaves Outlook, Teams, Copilot 365 and other Microsoft 365 services still inaccessible for users worldwide.
highlights: Outlook and Teams remain down according to Downdetector reports
Microsoft 365 outage also impacts OneDrive, OneNote, Microsoft ToDo and the web portal
Exec Charles Lamanna said there is no sign of malicious activity
Microsoft is scaling virtual machines and force‑syncing network changes to restore service

gemini4_hydrogen_pro_ultra.headline: Google unveils Gemini 4 Hydrogen for Pro and Ultra users
gemini4_hydrogen_pro_ultra.summary: Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model offers fast coding and agentic work at $1.50 per million input tokens, rolling out globally to Pro and Ultra subscribers.
highlights: Hydrogen costs $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens with a 1 million‑token context window
Orchestrator in Antigravity dynamically switches between Carbon and Hydrogen for parallel and isolated agents
Hydrogen is 2.5× faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash and cuts fabricated claims by more than fivefold
Google reports up to 81% less agentic overreach and a 96.7% honesty rate in internal tests

gemini_4_hydrogen_complex_questions.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, boosting complex query handling
gemini_4_hydrogen_complex_questions.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen model now answers multi‑part, typo‑laden and highly specific queries with richer visuals and faster, more intelligent responses.
highlights: Gemini 4 Hydrogen breaks down multi‑part questions and delivers answers for each segment
Adds low, medium, high and new “xhigh” thinking modes for customizable depth
Provides simultaneous subtopic queries, yielding broader link lists and visual aids
Claims speed and intelligence gains over Gemini Flash 3.8 and rivals Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT‑6.1 Terra

siriai_tvos27_2_1.headline: Siri AI Arrives on Older Apple TV 4K with tvOS 27.2.1 Update
siriai_tvos27_2_1.summary: Apple will enable Siri AI on 2nd‑ and 3rd‑generation Apple TV 4K via the upcoming tvOS 27.2.1 update, extending the feature beyond the newest model.
highlights: tvOS 27.2.1 adds Siri AI support for Apple TV 4K (2nd‑gen and later)
A special Siri AI build of tvOS 27.2 is already running on the 4th‑gen Apple TV 4K
The 4th‑gen Apple TV 4K ships with tvOS 27.0 and prompts users to upgrade to tvOS 27.2
Siri AI requires a nearby iPhone 15 Pro or later for activation

chatgpt_wallet_launch.headline: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet for Dots Agents to Make Purchases
chatgpt_wallet_launch.summary: OpenAI’s new ChatGPT Wallet lets Dots agents buy items for Pro users after biometric verification, without exposing actual card details.
highlights: ChatGPT Wallet rolls out to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18+
Agents use payment tokens, keeping real credit‑card numbers hidden
Each purchase requires a biometric security check like Face ID
Users can set spending limits and pre‑approve categories for autonomous buying

microsoft_outage_warning.headline: Microsoft 365 Outage Cripples Global Services, Sparks Resilience Debate
microsoft_outage_warning.summary: A multi‑day Microsoft 365 failure knocked out Outlook, Teams and Copilot, disrupting schools, courts and health services worldwide and exposing over‑reliance on a single cloud provider.
highlights: Outage traced to cascading server failures and health‑check errors across multiple data centers.
Millions of users in schools, governments and NHS faced email and scheduling disruptions.
Microsoft confirmed no cyberattack and is testing a configuration change to restore services.
Recent staff cuts and AI‑generated code raise questions about loss of tribal knowledge.
Officials worldwide call for independent fallback systems for mission‑critical services.

microsoft365outageresolution.headline: Microsoft 365 Outage Ends After Nearly 24 Hours of Global Disruption
microsoft365outageresolution.summary: Microsoft confirmed the Microsoft 365 outage, affecting Outlook, Teams and Copilot, was resolved after almost a full day, citing a network capacity upgrade issue.
highlights: Outage began around 1 p.m. ET Thursday and impacted Outlook email, Teams features, and Copilot access
Some users experienced errors scheduling meetings or adding calendar entries in Exchange via Apple Mail
Microsoft said the incident was unrelated to cyber‑attacks or AI agents and stemmed from a prior network upgrade
A full incident report will be released after the internal review is completed

chatgptwalletlaunch.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet enabling Dots agents to shop for users
chatgptwalletlaunch.summary: OpenAI's new ChatGPT Wallet lets US‑based ChatGPT Pro users authorize Dots agents to make purchases using tokenized credit cards and biometric checks.
highlights: ChatGPT Wallet is available to US‑based ChatGPT Pro subscribers with Visa, Mastercard or American Express cards
Purchases require user review and approval via Face ID or fingerprint scan
OpenAI released a Commerce Partner Playbook to help retailers accommodate AI‑agent shoppers
Retailers such as Amazon and United Airlines have recently blocked AI agents from their platforms

chatgptwalletrebuild.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI‑Powered Shopping in US
chatgptwalletrebuild.summary: OpenAI’s new **ChatGPT Wallet** enables AI agents to purchase items for **Pro** users, requiring Face ID or fingerprint verification for each transaction.
highlights: ChatGPT Wallet is available to **Pro** subscribers in the **US** via **Dots**
Payments use tokenized cards from **Visa**, **Mastercard**, and **American Express**, keeping real card details hidden
Competitors like **Anthropic**, **Meta**, and **xAI** already offer similar agent‑shopping capabilities

pixel_wifi_connectivity_issues_nov_updat.headline: Google Pixel November Update Disrupts Enterprise Wi‑Fi Connectivity
pixel_wifi_connectivity_issues_nov_updat.summary: The November 2026 Pixel update is preventing many users from connecting to workplace and school Wi‑Fi networks, showing “Saved/Connection failure” errors.
highlights: Affected Pixel devices show “Saved/Connection failure” when joining WPA2‑Enterprise networks
Issue spans multiple Pixel generations but only after the November 2026 update
Google has acknowledged the bug but has not provided a fix timeline

microsoft_outage_2026_11_14.headline: Microsoft Outage Cripples Exchange Online for Businesses and Governments Worldwide
microsoft_outage_2026_11_14.summary: A network glitch knocked Microsoft’s Exchange Online offline, affecting thousands of organizations across 70+ countries and disrupting related Teams, Copilot 365, and Intune services.
highlights: Exchange Online went down at 12:35 p.m. EST, triggering widespread email and calendar outages.
Microsoft Teams and Copilot 365 features that rely on Exchange data were also impacted.
Public sector entities, including U.S. municipalities and the U.K. National Pharmacy Association, reported service delays.
Recovery began early Thursday with patches to an upstream authentication/routing module restoring service in Asia Pacific, then

cursor_breach_fireworks_key.headline: Cursor Breach Traced to Fireworks AI Exposed Access Key
cursor_breach_fireworks_key.summary: An attacker used a Cursor-issued access key exposed by Fireworks AI to copy historic coding-agent traces, steal credentials, and distribute malicious Claude Code extensions.
highlights: Vendor‑exposed access key enabled data theft from a read‑only bucket used for Cursor’s data sharing
Less than 0.01% of customers had API credentials exposed, and live inference traffic remained safe
Malicious Claude Code builds were served via the VS Code marketplace for about 11 hours, affecting up to 5,000 users
Cursor rotated all exposed credentials, moved inference traffic off Fireworks, and added secret‑scanning across repositories

jensen_huang_departure_funding_impact.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s Exit Threatens AI Startup Funding Landscape
jensen_huang_departure_funding_impact.summary: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia’s CEO raises concerns that the chipmaker’s massive AI‑startup investments will shrink, unsettling valuations and deal flow.
highlights: Nvidia participated in 105 funding rounds this year, often as the largest investor
Huang’s departure may lead to smaller checks and more selective investments under interim CEO Colette Kress
Key portfolio companies like CoreWeave, Hugging Face, Mistral AI and Reflection AI could lose a major backer
Investors fear the slowdown could lower valuations and pause dealmaking across the AI ecosystem

nationwide_ground_stop_2026_wired.headline: FAA Halts All US Flights Amid Nationwide Radio Outage
nationwide_ground_stop_2026_wired.summary: The FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop on Friday after critical radio frequency outages crippled major Air Traffic Control Centers, grounding all US flights.
highlights: Radio frequency outages hit Boston, Chicago and New York ATC centers
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy linked the stop to a communications failure
FAA seeks swift congressional approval for $30.1 billion ATC modernization funding
New AI‑based SMART tool was not responsible for the outage

ceo_search.headline: NVIDIA Board Stalls CEO Search, Interim Leader Colette Kress Holds Dual Roles
ceo_search.summary: NVIDIA’s board says it has not formally engaged any candidates, leaving Colette Kress as interim CEO and CFO while the permanent search remains unresolved.
highlights: Board denies formal engagement with candidates, though reports cite approach to Arm CEO Rene Haas.
Colette Kress assumes interim CEO and CFO duties, maintaining leadership continuity.
NVIDIA shares slipped over 2%, pushing market cap below $4 trillion amid succession uncertainty.
Harvey C. Jones appointed as NVIDIA’s first‑ever board chair to oversee the search.

jensen_huang_ouster.headline: Nvidia’s Risky Credit Guarantees Spark Jensen Huang’s Ouster
jensen_huang_ouster.summary: Jensen Huang was forced out after Nvidia’s billion‑dollar credit program for AI cloud providers, including a $250 billion OpenAI deal, raised internal concerns.
highlights: Nvidia offered AI cloud providers billions in guarantees, driven by son‑in‑law Nico Caprez
Interim CEO Colette Kress halved the $250 billion OpenAI guarantee after valuation doubts
Shares fell 5% when the risky credit program became public

gemini4carbon_matharena_top.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon Tops MathArena, Costs 15× GPT-6.1 Sol
gemini4carbon_matharena_top.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon became the first non‑OpenAI model to lead the MathArena benchmark, but its runtime cost is about fifteen times higher than GPT‑6.1 Sol.
highlights: Gemini 4 Carbon dethroned GPT-6.1 Sol as MathArena champion
Claude Fable 5.2 placed second behind Gemini 4 Carbon
Carbon’s primary failure mode is exceeding time limits, once running over eleven hours

agentic_ai_business_processes.headline: AT&T Deploys Agentic AI to Overhaul Business Processes
agentic_ai_business_processes.summary: AT&T is scaling agentic AI, running 500 workflows and processing 45 billion tokens daily to automate and redesign core business operations.
highlights: Nearly 500 agentic workflows are in production, with plans to triple the count next year
The platform handles over 1 million transactions each month across the company
Business Agent Foundry maps processes to replace legacy steps and handoffs
AI investments are delivering fivefold returns within a year

claude_opus_5_5_default.headline: Anthropic urges users to drop outdated prompts for faster Claude Opus 5.5 performance
claude_opus_5_5_default.summary: Anthropic advises removing legacy prompting phrases and adjusting effort levels to unlock Claude Opus 5.5’s full speed and quality on Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team plans.
highlights: Cut phrases like “think hard” from prompts to speed up responses without quality loss
Start with the default “Medium” effort level, which matches Opus 5 on “High” in internal tests
Use a single, detailed message describing the goal, format, and follow‑up criteria
Attach diagrams or tables as images instead of typing data to leverage Opus 5.5’s improved reading
Prefer naming unwanted design styles rather than vague bans for better visual outputs

uber_driver_data_breach_third_party.headline: Uber Drivers’ Licenses Exposed After Fireworks.ai Hack
uber_driver_data_breach_third_party.summary: A breach of third‑party AI provider Fireworks.ai compromised personal data and driver’s licenses of thousands of Uber drivers across three states.
highlights: Hack occurred on October 9 targeting Fireworks.ai’s cloud platform.
Internal credentials were stolen and used to pull Uber driver data.
Licenses of 3,430 drivers in South Carolina, 2,567 in Massachusetts, and 1,873 in Rhode Island were exposed.
Attack attributed to a cybercriminal group selling stolen tokens for large language models.

mythos_retraining_efficiency_claim.headline: Anthropic Says Mythos Can Be Retrained With Fractional Compute, Ex‑Employee Claims
mythos_retraining_efficiency_claim.summary: Former researcher Jacob Coxon alleges Anthropic’s IPO slide shows Mythos can be retrained using far less compute, indicating accelerating algorithmic efficiency.
highlights: Anthropic’s IPO roadshow chart compresses the compute axis, making 10x‑100x growth appear similar
Coxon says Mythos was a point on a superexponential efficiency curve, not a one‑off jump
He warns that algorithmic improvements are nearing automation and urges a pause on frontier model development
The claim suggests competitors could catch up if compute requirements drop dramatically

anthropic_pre_ipo_uncertainty.headline: Anthropic CEO Warns of Massive Compute Uncertainty Ahead of Record IPO
anthropic_pre_ipo_uncertainty.summary: Days before a historic IPO, Anthropic chief Dario Amodei says the company faces huge uncertainty over future compute spending and revenue alignment.
highlights: Anthropic has committed nearly $901 billion to compute and chips, with $71 billion due by September 2027
The company aims to raise up to $64.4 billion in the IPO and $26 billion via private placement
Annualized revenue run rate reached $81 billion in October, driven by AI products including coding models

evt_e3ad2fed89.headline: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI

evt_deb7d9181c.headline: Xbox CEO calls Project Helix a ‘family of devices’

evt_d95f2f58c0.headline: Anthropic Reports Claude Agents Mitigated Ten Alignment Failures

evt_f6d8845f27.headline: Microsoft Teams Has Become a Haven for Scammers in China

evt_dff09201e2.headline: Which Macs Will Get an M6 Chip and Which Won't?
